metadata.dayModel: civil day with preceding service-day spillover
metadata.label: Fribourg canton — archival source-line study

timetable.publisher: SBB / Open data platform mobility Switzerland
timetable.refreshPolicy: Pinned September 2026 research fixtures; not a live or current-service feed. A new timetable or geometry release requires a complete rebuild and admission audit.

metadata.model: Scheduled interpolation along cantonal source centrelines; exactTimes=0 instances are representative headway motion, not exact departures or observed vehicles.
metadata.scope: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Fribourg canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Fribourg. No operator whitelist.
metadata.admission: Only complete directed patterns with every segment passing geometry limits and no reservation/on-demand call. Exclusions retained in the canton audit.

geometry.publisher: Etat de Fribourg / Service de la mobilité / SIT
geometry.vintageNote: The embedded Esri CreaDate dates metadata only. No geometry update date is declared. PDF timetable dates do not date line geometry.
geometry.license: Dataset-specific vector redistribution terms unresolved; no Creative Commons licence assigned

reuseEvidence.assessment: OCGéo art. 12 requires attribution for reproduction; annex 2 classifies the cantonal public transport plan 56-FR as level A. The service metadata does not establish that this line layer is that exact dataset or supply vector terms. Preserve this supporting evidence without claiming a dataset-specific licence. Local archival research feed only until clarified.

geometry.transformation: swisstopo approximate CH1903+/WGS84 formula; original LV95 vertices, no simplification, seven-decimal output coordinates
geometry.direction: Bidirectional centreline inference from ordered calls. No road one-way or rail running-track certification; no realtime/diversion verification.
